query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.tradeName, p.currentBalance, p.creditLimit, p.companyId,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM sales s WHERE s.customerId = p.id AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE') as totalVendas,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cd.debitAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM customerDebits cd WHERE cd.customerId = p.id) as totalDebitos,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cp.paidAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM customerPayments cp WHERE cp.customerId = p.id) as totalPagamentos,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM sales s WHERE s.customerId = p.id AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE')
  + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cd.debitAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM customerDebits cd WHERE cd.customerId = p.id)
  - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cp.paidAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM customerPayments cp WHERE cp.customerId = p.id) as saldoCalculado
FROM partners p 
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Savio%' OR p.tradeName LIKE '%Savio%';
